title: Lamparo App Review 2026: Risk Check
description: Thinking of signing up with Lamparo App? Its page lists futures trading, bank card deposits and a $250 minimum, but names no regulator or licence.
author: James Whitmore
excerpt: The page is headed "legit or not?" without evidence.
content:
The page is headed "legit or not?" without evidence. It is an app offering futures trading paid by bank card, with no named licence or company. Outside verification was not run.

What the page says

  • Platform type: online trading platform
  • Technology: AI technology
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: futures
  • Payment methods: bank cards
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal usually within a day
  • Registration fee: no registration fee
  • Support: 24/7 support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
